prompts.cloth: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color material for an anime fantasy 3D garment. Generate ONE square orthographic flat swatch of fine undyed woven linen, neutral light grey, tiny tidy warp and weft, understated hand-painted anime game finish. Texture fills image edge to edge, consistent texel scale and brightness, seamlessly repeating on all four edges. No folds, clothing silhouette, borders, text, shadows, directional lighting, highlights or perspective. This will be tinted in a shader and used as fabric albedo, not a photograph of clothing.
prompts.leather: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color material for anime fantasy leather armor. Generate ONE square orthographic flat swatch of fine grained smooth leather, neutral medium grey, subtle irregular pores, restrained hand-painted anime game finish. Texture fills image edge to edge, consistent texel scale and brightness, seamlessly repeating on all four edges. No seams, stitches, buckles, folds, silhouette, text, borders, lighting gradients or cast shadows. This is tintable leather albedo.
prompts.mail: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable chainmail material for an anime fantasy game. Generate ONE square flat orthographic macro swatch of clearly interlocking small iron rings in consistent European four-in-one rows. Neutral grey metal rings, darker small gaps, same ring size throughout, uniform flat illumination. Approximately 18 rows across the full image. Edges repeat seamlessly. Crisp readable anime game material rather than photorealistic noise. No fabric folds, garment, text, borders, perspective, large highlights, dramatic shadows or surrounding background.
prompts.iron: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color texture for anime fantasy iron plate armor. Generate ONE square orthographic flat swatch of clean forged iron, neutral medium-light grey, very subtle hammering and fine surface scratches, understated hand-painted anime finish. Seamless edges, consistent brightness, edge-to-edge flat material. No rust patches, engraved ornaments, seams, rivets, armor silhouette, bevels, borders, text, reflections, directional light or dramatic baked highlights. This is tintable iron albedo to combine with a separate normal map.
